description: This file defines the StartsWithBinary class in Twig, which implements an expression node for checking if one string starts with another within the Twig template engine. It includes methods for compilation to PHP code.

classes.name: StartsWithBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary expression node for checking if a string starts with another string in Twig templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to evaluate whether the left string starts with the right string, using PHP's str_starts_with function.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating no custom operator representation is needed.
